description: National Mission for Financial Inclusion providing Rs. 2 Lakh accident cover, Rs. 30,000 life cover, and Rs. 10,000 overdraft.
eligibility: Indian citizen aged 10+ without bank account.
excerpt: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) (Central) under Financial Inclusion: Rs 2 Lakh insurance, overdraft facility.

description: Income support scheme providing Rs. 6000 per year per family in three equal installments of Rs. 2000.
application_process: Register at PM-KISAN portal or CSC.
excerpt: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) (Central) under Agriculture: Rs 6000 per year income support.

description: Health insurance scheme offering coverage up to Rs. 5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization.
excerpt: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY (Central) under Health & Medical: Rs 5 Lakh cashless health cover.

description: Housing for all mission providing interest subsidy on home loans for EWS, LIG, and MIG families.
eligibility: Families not owning pucca house in India.
benefits: Up to Rs 2.67 Lakh interest subsidy.
excerpt: PM Awas Yojana (PMAY-Urban) (Central) under Housing & Urban: Up to Rs 2.67 Lakh interest subsidy.

description: Free deposit-free LPG connection to adult women from BPL households.
benefits: Free LPG connection with financial support of Rs 1600.
excerpt: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) (Central) under Energy & Social Welfare: Free LPG connection with financial support of Rs 1600.

description: Maternity benefit scheme providing cash incentive of Rs. 5000 directly to bank accounts of pregnant women and lactating mothers.
excerpt: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) (Central) under Women & Child Development: Rs 5000 in three installments.

description: Special micro-credit facility providing collateral-free working capital loan up to Rs. 10,000 for street vendors.
eligibility: Urban street vendors with vending certificate.
excerpt: PM SVANidhi (Street Vendor Special Micro-Credit) (Central) under Micro Credit & Livelihood: Collateral-free working capital loan.

description: Bank loans between Rs. 10 Lakh and Rs. 1 Crore to SC/ST or woman borrowers for setting up greenfield enterprise.
benefits: Rs 10 Lakh to Rs 1 Crore greenfield loan.
application_process: Apply at Stand Up India portal.
excerpt: Stand Up India Scheme (Central) under Banking & Entrepreneurship: Rs 10 Lakh to Rs 1 Crore greenfield loan.

description: National scheme for providing cooked nutritious meal to children studying in classes I to VIII in government schools.
eligibility: Children enrolled in primary/upper primary govt schools.
excerpt: PM POSHAN (Mid Day Meal Scheme) (Central) under Education & Nutrition: Free hot cooked nutritious meal.

description: Comprehensive scheme providing skill training, toolkit incentive of Rs. 15,000, and collateral-free credit support to traditional artisans.
excerpt: PM Vishwakarma Scheme (Central) under Skill Development & Artisans: Rs 15,000 toolkit digital voucher.

description: State welfare scheme of Madhya Pradesh offering educational and financial milestone payments up to age 21 for girl child.
eligibility: Girl child born in MP to non-taxpayer resident parents.
benefits: Milestone educational grants and Rs 1 Lakh at age 21.
excerpt: Ladli Laxmi Yojana (Madhya Pradesh) (Madhya Pradesh) under Women & Child Development: Milestone educational grants and Rs 1 Lakh at age 21.

description: Financial assistance scheme providing Rs. 1250 per month directly to eligible women of Madhya Pradesh.
benefits: Rs 1250 per month direct bank transfer.
excerpt: Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana (Madhya Pradesh) (Madhya Pradesh) under Women Welfare: Rs 1250 per month direct bank transfer.

description: Financial assistance of Rs. 51,000 for marriage of destitute, widowed or divorced women in Madhya Pradesh.
eligibility: Resident bride of MP aged 18+ from BPL family.
excerpt: MP Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivah Yojana (Madhya Pradesh) under Social Security: Rs 51,000 financial assistance.

description: Financial assistance deposited in name of girl child born in Delhi at milestones of birth, school admission, and class 12 completion.
eligibility: Girl child born in Delhi with family income under Rs 1 Lakh.
benefits: Up to Rs 100,000 maturity benefit at age 18.
application_process: Apply through school or WCD Delhi office.
excerpt: Delhi Ladli Scheme (Delhi) under Women & Child Development: Up to Rs 100,000 maturity benefit at age 18.

scheme_name: Delhi Pension Scheme for Persons with Disabilities
description: Monthly pension of Rs. 2500 for persons with 40% or more disability residing in Delhi.
excerpt: Delhi Pension Scheme for Persons with Disabilities (Delhi) under Social Welfare: Rs 2500 monthly pension.

scheme_name: Maharashtra Majhi Kanya Bhagya Shree Scheme
description: Financial assistance of Rs. 50,000 deposited in bank for single girl child family in Maharashtra.
eligibility: BPL family in Maharashtra with girl child.
application_process: Apply at Women & Child Development office.
excerpt: Maharashtra Majhi Kanya Bhagya Shree Scheme (Maharashtra) under Women & Child Development: Rs 50,000 fixed deposit.

description: Monthly financial assistance of Rs. 1000 for girl students pursuing higher education who studied in TN govt schools.
eligibility: Girl student in TN pursuing degree/diploma.
excerpt: Tamil Nadu Pudhumai Penn Scheme (Tamil Nadu) under Education: Rs 1000 per month.

description: Financial assistance of Rs. 2000 per month to female head of household in Karnataka.
excerpt: Karnataka Gruha Lakshmi Scheme (Karnataka) under Women Empowerment: Rs 2000 monthly direct bank transfer.
